Hold amiodarone if this interaction is confirmed.

runs.question: My patient takes digoxin. Can I add amiodarone?
runs.final_answer:
This combination is NOT RECOMMENDED.

Amiodarone inhibits P-glycoprotein, reducing renal clearance of digoxin and increasing its plasma concentration by 70-100%. This can lead to an increased risk of digoxin toxicity, including bradycardia, AV block, and arrhythmias.

Halve the digoxin dose when starting amiodarone and monitor closely.
